about: Pinned conversions between LV95 + LN02 height and Godot local coordinates for config/world.json schema 1 (SPEC section 6). The two address points and the Matterhorn name point carry swisstopo's own eastings and northings (address search and gazetteer, read 2026-09-24). Heights are synthetic round values chosen for the test, not measured terrain heights. Read by pipeline/tests/test_world.py and game/tests/test_world_config.gd.

vectors.name: 20 km east and 20 km south of the origin
